decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The linked PR fills in what the one-line changelog entry [ev-9b56ac76a332] leaves out. It adds a new opt-in option to the Nomad provider that allows empty services, so a route persists when a service is scaled down to 0. The option is "false by default" [ev-466bcd622184]. It is modelled on the Kubernetes provider's existing option, and the service list now comes from Nomad's job API rather than its service API [ev-6ff10ab3a2a9]. The PR also changes the Nomad provider config and static-configuration reference docs [ev-1645992a8c40]. That is enough to write the assertion: the change is an added option, off by default, it applies only to Nomad provider users who turn it on, and nothing happens to operators who do nothing. The one gap is that the excerpts never quote the exact configuration key name.
